newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose across the board on Friday following the 0.75 percentage point increase in the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate to 11 percent, dealers said.
The Central Bank was forced to increase its rate to calm in a jittery market over possible large outflows from stock market sales.
Traders said the Central Bank may again have to increase its rates to stem the outflow from foreign funds.
The local stock market plunged to two-year lows due to fears of a slump in the property segment and poor first quarter earnings.
